emulators.name: Eglantine (Djihads80)
emulators.note: Base de la familia y punto de partida habitual. Versiones preliminares.
emulators.note_en: Main upstream of the family and the usual starting point. Pre-release builds.

emulators.name: Eglantine (SmileyTatsu)
emulators.note: Fork orientado a Mario Kart World.
emulators.note_en: Fork aimed at Mario Kart World.

emulators.name: Orchid
emulators.note: Independiente desde que se separó de Eglantine; orientado a Ocarina of Time.
emulators.note_en: Independent since leaving Eglantine; aimed at Ocarina of Time.

emulators.name: Lichii (zortos293)
emulators.note: Fork grande derivado de Eglantine que también ejecuta juegos de Switch 1.
emulators.note_en: Large Eglantine-derived fork that also runs Switch 1 titles.

emulators.name: Eglantine (notsapinho)
emulators.note: Compilación pequeña orientada a Pokémon Pokopia; la de Linux x86_64 necesita AVX2.
emulators.note_en: Small build aimed at Pokémon Pokopia; the Linux x86_64 build needs AVX2.

emulators.name: selevet-eglantine
emulators.note: Ajustada para procesadores Zen 3; recomendada para Donkey Kong Bananza.
emulators.note_en: Tuned for Zen 3 processors; recommended for Donkey Kong Bananza.

emulators.name: Droplet
emulators.note: Juego en línea privado con servidor propio. No lee NSP/XCI cifrados, solo carpetas descifradas.
emulators.note_en: Private online play with a self-hosted server. It cannot read encrypted NSP/XCI files, only decrypted folders.

emulators.name: Eglantine (rdenno)
emulators.note: Tiene una rama nx2-merged, útil para Hyrule Warriors. Proyecto muy pequeño.
emulators.note_en: Has an nx2-merged branch, useful for Hyrule Warriors. Very small project.

note_en: Community forks of the Eden code base. Experimental, not Eden team releases; official Eden does not run Switch 2 games in its stable release. Deck Library does not ship, download or update any of them.
note: Forks comunitarios del código de Eden. Son experimentales y no son versiones del equipo de Eden; Eden oficial no ejecuta juegos de Switch 2 en su versión estable. Deck Library no los incluye, descarga ni actualiza.
